「同感です。目に見えて判るような異状はないでしょうが、丁寧に見回れば手がかりは得られるはずです」

pages.en:
“Tonight, we’ll patrol Miyama. Things have felt strange lately, and I want to investigate before something catches us unprepared.”

“I agree. There may be no abnormalities obvious to the eye, but a careful search should yield some clue.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“We’ll search this town tonight. The town feels strange recently, so let’s investigate here before something happens.”
“I feel the same way. There are no obvious abnormalities, but I am sure we will find some clues if we search thoroughly.”

pages.ja:

その後は交差点に降りて、洋館側の住宅地を巡回する。
それで異状が見られなければ新都に移動して、手がかりを見つけだせばいい

pages.en:
…Right. We will begin with the residential district on this side.

After that, we will descend to the intersection and patrol the neighborhood around the western-style houses.

If we find nothing unusual there, we can cross into Shinto and search for a lead—
pages.mirrorMoon:
…Yeah, we’ll look around the residential district over here first.
We’ll go down to the intersection after that and patrol the other side of town.
If we can’t find anything wrong, we can go to Shinto to go look for some clues

pages.en:
After making a circuit of the residential district, we descend to the intersection.

There was nothing unusual on our side.

That leaves the hill near the western-style houses. If we mean to cast a wider net, we might even go as far as Ryuudou Temple—
pages.mirrorMoon:
We patrol the residential district and make our way to the intersection.
There wasn’t anything wrong with our side of town.
We can now go to the hill with the Western-style houses, and maybe even go as far as the Ryuudou Temple

pages.ja:
「
え？」
背中から湧き上がってくる悪寒。
「セイバー、これ……！？」
俺より正確に感じ取ったのか、セイバーは新都の方角に視線を向ける。

pages.en:
“—What?”

A chill wells up along my spine.

“Saber, this is—!?”

Perhaps sensing it more clearly than I do, Saber turns her gaze toward Shinto.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Huh?”
A sudden chill runs up my spine.
“Saber, this is…!”
Saber must have felt it more clearly, as she looks over towards Shinto.

pages.ja:

だが、今のは間違いなく誰かの悲鳴であり、強い魔力の余波だった。
「
」
判っていた。
始めからこうなる事を望んで外に出たのだ。
だっていうのに、どうして頭が麻痺しているのか。

pages.en:
…The presence we detected is fading.

But there is no mistaking what we felt: someone’s scream and the aftershock of powerful magical energy.

“——”

I knew this would happen.

I left the house precisely because I wanted to find it.

So why has my mind gone numb?
pages.mirrorMoon:
…The presence I felt starts to fade.
But I’m sure I heard a scream and felt a strong wave of magical energy.
“
”
I knew it.
This is what I hoped would happen.
So why is my mind paralyzed?

pages.ja:

っ」
戦う覚悟はあった。
躊躇いは死にかけた時に消えている。
なのに体は動かず、頭は次の行動を命じてくれない。

pages.en:
“——”

I was prepared to fight.

Any hesitation disappeared when I nearly died.

Yet my body refuses to move, and my mind cannot order the next action.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
!”
I was prepared to fight.
After I almost died, my hesitation vanished.
But now my body would not move, and my head would not give any orders.

pages.ja:
きっと早すぎる。
だって、幾らなんでも一日目で当たりを引くなんて思わなかった。
だから動けない。襲われる事には慣れても、自分から襲う事に慣れていない。
なんて間抜け。
自分が殺される事はいいってのに、自分が殺す事を考えてもいな

pages.en:
—It was too soon.

No matter what I told myself, I never imagined we would find our quarry on the first night.

That is why I cannot move. I have grown accustomed to being attacked, but not to attacking someone myself.

What an idiot.

I can accept being killed, yet never once considered what it would mean for me to kill—
pages.mirrorMoon:
It’s probably too sudden.
I didn’t expect to find it on the first day.
That’s why I can’t move. I’m used to getting attacked, but I’m not used to doing the attacking.
How stupid of me.
I’m fine with getting killed, but I never thought that I might have to do it myself

pages.ja: 「悲鳴が止みました。感じ取れる気配も消えかけています。何が起きたかは判りませんが、このままでは襲われた者は助からないでしょう」
pages.jaRuby: 「悲鳴が止みました。感じ取れる気配も消えかけています。何が起きたかは判りませんが、このままでは襲われた者は助からないでしょう」
pages.en: “The scream has stopped. The presence I sensed is nearly gone. I do not know what occurred, but at this rate, whoever was attacked will not survive.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “The scream has stopped. The presence is fading away. I do not know what happened, but the victim will not live long.”

固まっていた頭、手足の痺れが解ける。
殺し合いをするのだ、という恐れは、
誰かを見殺しにするのだ、という恐れにかき消された。

pages.en:
“——”

And just like that, the paralysis vanishes.

My frozen thoughts and numbed limbs come free.

The fear that I am going to enter a battle to the death is drowned beneath the fear that I am about to abandon someone to die.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
That erases everything.
The numbness throughout my body disappears.
The fear that I might kill,
is overridden by the fear that I might let someone die.

pages.ja:
「すまん、セイバー……！」
自分の不甲斐なさを詫びて、全力で走り出す。
悲鳴の元、不吉な魔力が残る殺し合いの場へ。
覚悟は出来ていない。
走り出す足は震えている。
それは正しい。
戦う意思、聖杯を欲する欲望がないのなら、この恐れは必ずついて回る。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“I’m sorry, Saber…!”

Apologizing for my weakness, I break into a run with all my strength.

Toward the source of the scream. Toward the site of a deadly struggle where ominous magical energy still lingers.

I am not prepared.

My legs tremble as I run.

—That is only right.

Without the will to fight or the desire to possess the Holy Grail, this fear will follow me wherever I go.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I’m sorry, Saber…!”
I apologize for my cowardice and start to run full-speed.
We run to the origin of the scream, where we will fight someone to the death.
I’m not prepared at all.
My limbs are shaking.
It’s a normal reaction.
This fear will always be there as long as I don’t desire the Holy Grail and lack the will to fight.

そう。
故に、戦うと決めた理由があるのなら、まずそれを抱かなければならなかった。
相手が“聖杯が欲しい”という願望で心を武装するのなら。
衛宮士郎は、“戦いを止める”という願望で、この恐れを打ち消していくしかないのだと
！

pages.en:
“—What a fool. What a complete idiot…!”

Yes.

If I have chosen to fight for a reason, then that reason must be the first thing I hold within myself.

If my enemy arms his heart with the desire to possess the Holy Grail,

then Shirou Emiya can overcome this fear only with his own desire—to end the fighting—!
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
I’m a big damn idiot…!”
That’s right.
If I have a reason to fight, I must believe in it.
If my enemies are arming their minds with “the desire for the Holy Grail”…
I must defeat this fear with “the desire to stop all conflicts”
!
